name: Gasztony (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gasztony: a blue shield with a white figure, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll inscribed GASZTONY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gasztony arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
